doctrine: Orbital is the primary operator surface.
Orbital should become voice-native: Lenox talks, Alfred directs, Orbital operates.
Third Signal Agent Wiki should become the compiled, cited operating memory behind Orbital agents.
Third Signal SWAT should govern parallel agent missions with OUP gates, source-truth checks, Integration Sentinel review and no production deploy without explicit approval.
Orbital Context should capture live browser/app proof and route it through Swarm, Librarian, Agent Wiki, Field Guide, Armory/Ghost, Research OS and #admin.
Field Guide is the intended living documentation layer, but Swarm retrieval is not confirmed until THI-56 is complete.
Armory is an Orbital module updated by Librarian and used by Ghost; its module path and runtime wiring still need confirmation.
Swarm owns coordination, trace IDs and handoffs.
Third-party tools are provider adapters behind Orbital, not places the operator must live.
Production changes require Linear and Librarian documentation.
